decisions.rationale: origin has 3 distinct values and time_hour has 4341 distinct values; 3 x 4341 = 13023, close to the 13014 row_count, so one row per station per hour (origin, time_hour) is the plausible grain, with a few station-hours missing. A human should measure uniqueness against the warehouse before approval.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 13014, so no dedupe step is proposed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata and are dropped; _airbyte_meta is constant '{}' and the extraction timestamps span only three seconds.
year, month, day, and hour landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every distinct or sampled value is integral (year fixed at 2013, month 1-6, day 1-31, hour 0-23), so they are cast to INTEGER.
All sampled time_hour values are ISO-8601 UTC strings like 2013-01-01T06:00:00Z, so the column is cast from VARCHAR to TIMESTAMP.
wind_gust has null_rate 0.745505 (9702 of 13014 rows null); the column is retained as nullable rather than dropped or imputed because gusts are genuinely absent in calm conditions.

purpose: Hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, cleaned from the bronze Airbyte landing table. It provides temperature, dew point, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility measures keyed by station and observation hour, intended to feed flight-delay and weather-correlation analyses downstream.
usage: Join on (origin, time_hour), the declared grain; time_hour is a proper TIMESTAMP in UTC and the year/month/day/hour integer parts are redundant with it and provided for convenience. Consumers must handle nulls deliberately: wind_gust is null on roughly 75% of rows, pressure on about 11%, and wind_dir on about 1.7%; nulls mean no reading was captured, not zero.
limitations: Coverage is limited to 2013 months 1-6 and three stations. wind_gust is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure has null_rate 0.114953; no imputation was performed. wind_speed shows a maximum of 1048.36058, which looks like a unit or sensor anomaly that the cleanup does not correct. The (origin, time_hour) grain implies up to 13023 station-hours but only 13014 rows landed, so a few hours are missing, and grain uniqueness has not yet been measured against the warehouse.
